title: Scaling Point-in-Time Language Models: Enabling Economic Evaluation of Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2607.11889v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models trained on unrestricted internet corpora inevitably embed information from the future, introducing lookahead bias that compromises the validity of backtests and causal inference in finance and the social sciences. Point-in-time language models--trained exclusively on text available up to each calendar date--eliminate this leakage by construction, but existing efforts typically produce models that lag substantially behind their unconstrained counterparts. We show that this performance gap can be substantially narrowed through scale. Training decoder-only transformers with up to 4 billion parameters on 1 trillion chronologically filtered tokens from FineWeb, we construct a sequence of monthly model checkpoints spanning 2013-2024. translated_title: 时点语言模型的规模化：使嵌入的经济评估成为可能
translated_abstract: 在无限制互联网语料库上训练的大型语言模型不可避免地会嵌入来自未来的信息，从而引入前视偏差（lookahead bias），损害金融和社会科学领域回测与因果推断的有效性。时点语言模型——仅使用截至每个日历日期可获得的文本进行训练——在构建上消除了这种信息泄漏，但现有工作通常得到的模型性能明显落后于无约束的对应模型。我们证明，这种性能差距可以通过规模化来显著缩小。我们在来自FineWeb的1万亿个按时间顺序过滤的token上训练了参数量高达40亿的仅解码器Transformer，构建了涵盖2013至2024年的月度模型检查点序列。在一系列常识推理和语言理解基准测试中，我们的模型接近同等规模的领先开源权重模型（如Gemma-3-4B等）的性能。
tldr: 通过在按时间过滤的1万亿token上训练高达40亿参数的时点语言模型并发布2013–2024年的月度检查点，显著缩小了时点模型与无约束模型之间的性能差距，从而为金融与社会科学提供了无前视偏差的经济评估嵌入。
en_tdlr: By scaling point-in-time language models up to 4 billion parameters trained on 1 trillion chronologically filtered tokens with monthly checkpoints spanning 2013–2024, the performance gap with unconstrained models is substantially narrowed, enabling lookahead-bias-free embeddings for economic evaluation in finance and social sciences.
